data.statement: Implement the Narrator Voice Single-Document Implementation Plan: replace fragmented narrator persistence with one strict authoritative narrator_voice.json document, canonical per-profile WAV ownership, selection by profile id, atomic AI resume state, updated downstream consumers, lifecycle/reset/export behavior, tests, requirements, and documentation, with no legacy reader or migration.

acceptance: narrator_voice.json has the exact seven-field root contract and is the only narrator metadata authority; malformed current documents raise an operator-facing contract error without replacement; profiles have unique immutable ids and at most one canonical audio_narator_<normalized_profile_id>.wav; selection writes only selected_profile_id; generated/imported samples store compact metadata in their profile; AI cancellation/failure preserves resumable matching state and profiles, while success atomically appends validated profiles and clears resume; downstream services, manifest healing, export, snapshots, reset, and preservation use the new contract; obsolete narrator artifacts are never read, created, migrated, repaired, copied, or deleted by normal application flows; required focused and full deterministic tests, traceability, coverage, documentation, and style gates pass.
assumptions: The attached implementation plan is the authoritative product decision record; its exact document fields and explicit non-goals are closed to extension unless the user routes back to alignment or requirement.
Existing unrelated worktree changes in .agentic/workflow.toml and .codex/config.toml, plus the untracked planning document, remain user-owned and will be preserved.
The plan intentionally rejects backward compatibility; recovery from malformed current data is operator-visible and reset-driven rather than automatic.
All mapped target components currently satisfy the repository baseline-usable adoption threshold.
open_questions: Approve proceeding to Requirement work despite the high-risk, intentionally compatibility-breaking narrator persistence replacement and its cross-component regression surface?
planned_paths: 04_Software/AudioMancer/tests focused narrator, consumer, lifecycle, export, controller, and regression suites
data.reason: The change deliberately removes compatibility and rewires high-criticality voice, project-lifecycle, orchestration, and TTS consumers. Repository policy requires pause when risk is medium or higher.
recommended_responses: Approve the high-risk alignment exactly as recorded and continue to the Requirement gate, preserving the plan non-goals and requiring red-before-green tests before implementation.
scope: In scope: narrator document ownership and strict validation; profile/sample/selection APIs; AI profile-generation checkpoint and completion persistence; Narrator Voice and applicable Character Voices UI integration; selected-narrator consumers in Character Voices and Audio Blocks; project manifest projection, completion healing, export, snapshots, reset and preservation; configuration; focused and regression tests; durable requirements; component and user-facing documentation. Out of scope: visible workflow redesign, VoiceWeaver contracts, prompt and language rules, raw model payload persistence, Character Voices metadata consolidation, legacy readers or migrations, and delivery actions.
data.source: 0_Planning/Narrator_Voice_Implementation_Plan.md plus user instruction to implement it and explicit approval to park the Text Chunking run on 2026-07-21
data.understanding: Replace the fragmented Narrator Voice persistence model with one strictly validated authoritative narrator_voice.json document. Profiles, compact sample metadata, selected_profile_id, AI attempt usage/budget/instructions, and resumable style observations live in that document; WAV bytes remain canonical per-profile files. Selection performs no metadata or audio copy, downstream readers resolve the selected profile at read time, AI checkpoints and final profile append are atomic, logs remain separate, and obsolete artifacts receive no compatibility reader, migration, import, repair, rename, or deletion behavior.

data.summary: Intent alignment recorded from Narrator_Voice_Implementation_Plan.md with exact single-document scope, explicit non-goals, mapped baseline-usable components, high risk, and mandatory human approval before Requirement work.

Requirement gate accepted six testable Narrator Voice specs; revised REQ-FUNC-034 from legacy tolerance to strict current-document behavior; and added planned REQ-FUNC-055 through REQ-FUNC-058 for canonical profile/sample ownership, atomic AI resume, downstream selection resolution, and lifecycle/export/reset behavior.

Updated integration tests now target narrator_voice.json and canonical profile WAVs. Non-Qt focused suite reached 163 passed, 1 skipped, with one remaining product regression: imported Character Voices samples are no longer recognized as runtime-ready after narrator sample-contract tightening.

data.rationale: A strict current-document boundary prevents split-brain narrator state and makes incompatible project data operator-visible instead of silently repairing or importing it.
data.requirement: Narrator definition/state shall use one authoritative `narrator_voice.json` document with exactly the approved root, profile, sample, and resume fields; initialize the exact default only when the document is absent; reject a malformed current document without overwriting it; ignore every removed narrator artifact; and derive inventory, selected language, selection, and readiness from the current document plus canonical profile WAV presence.
data.verification: Strict document and removed-artifact contract test passes.

data.rationale: Stable profile ownership removes duplicated selected artifacts while preserving explicit review and independent samples.
data.requirement: Narrator profile, sample, and selection mutations shall update the authoritative document atomically, keep each profile identity immutable and unique, store compact sample metadata inside its profile, use only `audio_narator_<normalized_profile_id>.wav` for sample bytes, preserve that WAV across display-name edits, repair invalid selection after edit/delete, and persist selection only as `selected_profile_id` without JSON or WAV copies.
data.verification: Canonical profile WAV ownership and no-copy selection test passes.

data.rationale: One transaction document must support safe retries without coupling durable state to diagnostic files or publishing partial profile inventories.
data.requirement: Narrator AI profile generation shall atomically persist attempt status, cumulative token usage, budget metadata, current instructions, and a deterministic compact resume checkpoint in `narrator_voice.json`; retain matching resume state and leave profiles unchanged on cancellation/failure; append all validated profiles and clear resume in one write on success; and keep transaction logs separate without report/state sidecars, raw model payloads, persisted log paths, or generated-ID arrays.
data.verification: Compact AI resume checkpoint test passes; success-path companion test also passes.

data.rationale: Every selected-narrator consumer must share one truthful resolution path and cannot revive the fragmented persistence contract indirectly.
data.requirement: Character Voices, Audio Blocks, narrator state, and applicable UI controllers shall resolve the selected narrator profile, compact sample metadata, derived language, and canonical profile WAV at read time through the narrator document service, report not-ready when metadata or WAV is missing, and never open or depend on removed narrator metadata or selected-copy artifacts.

data.rationale: Project lifecycle operations must remain accurate and scoped while treating obsolete files as out-of-contract data rather than migration or cleanup inputs.
data.requirement: Project completion healing, manifest projection, Narrator Voice export, snapshots, reset, and preservation shall derive narrator state from `narrator_voice.json` plus canonical profile WAVs; export the authoritative document and valid profile samples; exclude narrator AI logs from snapshots; delete the authoritative document, canonical profile WAV pattern, and actual narrator-profile log pattern only when narrator definition is in reset scope; preserve them when requested; and neither inspect nor delete removed-contract artifacts.
data.verification: Reset and lifecycle current-artifact scoping test passes; export companion test passes.

data.summary: Implementation complete: strict narrator monofile ownership, canonical sample resolution, atomic AI resume/success, downstream consumers, lifecycle/reset/export, focused tests, durable requirements, component docs, software docs, and changelog updated. Documentation changed-only audit passes.
